plugins.name: skeptic-code
plugins.description: Adversarial engineering skill — nothing gets a verdict without evidence. Five modes: AUTO (implementation guard), QUICK (top-5 review), DEEP (full YAGNI/KISS/DRY audit), BUG (symptom-first defect investigation), ARCHITECTURE (boundary and dependency review). Independent verification by a fresh checker for material changes.
